findings.detail: EN 'son of a senior parliamentary figure' becomes generic 'сын высокопоставленного политика'; preserve the parliamentary connection.
EN 'their breaths brush on each other's faces' loses reciprocity in RU 'дыхание касается лица Калеба'; render both characters' breaths touching the other's face.
EN 'Caleb’s heart sinks' translated as calque 'Сердце Калеба падает'; replace with natural Russian preserving sudden emotional sinking.
EN Landon 'squeezing his arm' rendered as 'рука Лэндона мягко сжимает его плечо'; avoid adding shoulder anatomy absent from source.

Later EN 'his hand still resting gently on Caleb’s arm' rendered with ambiguous 'его рука ... на предплечье'; clarify that Landon's hand remains on Caleb's arm, without adding unsupported specificity.
